title: Autonomous Telerehabilitation via Skeletal Motion Prediction and Joint-Level Performance Assessment
abstract: arXiv:2608.12145v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autonomous rehabilitation systems must not only recognize human motion but also provide structured feedback to support users without continuous therapist supervision. This paper presents a telerehabilitation pipeline that integrates skeleton-based exercise quality assessment and short-term motion prediction into a two-module system operating on marker-free RGB video. A self-attentive Bidirectional LSTM performs exercise quality classification using MMD-NCA metric learning, while a graph-based motion prediction module computes per-joint position errors between predicted and observed poses, generating spatially localized deviation signals. translated_title: 基于骨骼运动预测与关节级表现评估的自主远程康复系统
translated_abstract: 自主康复系统不仅需要识别人体运动，还必须提供结构化反馈，以在无持续治疗师监督的情况下支持用户。本文提出了一种远程康复流水线，将基于骨骼的运动质量评估和短期运动预测集成到一个基于无标记RGB视频的双模块系统中。一个自注意力双向长短期记忆网络使用MMD-NCA度量学习进行运动质量分类，而一个基于图的运动预测模块计算预测姿态与观测姿态之间的各关节位置误差，生成空间局部化的偏差信号。每个模块在既有基准上独立评估：分类器在PROZIS数据集的下蹲序列上达到96.45%的平均类别准确率，采用的STARS预测器在Human3.6M上于560毫秒时达到平均MPJPE为75.8毫米，在所有时间步上优于图基和递归基线模型。
tldr: 本文提出了一种双模块远程康复系统，结合自注意力双向LSTM和基于图的运动预测，实现无标记视频下的自主运动质量评估与关节级偏差反馈，在多个基准上达到领先性能。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a two-module telerehabilitation system combining a self-attentive BiLSTM and graph-based motion prediction for marker-free video-based autonomous exercise quality assessment and joint-level deviation feedback, achieving state-of-the-art performance on multiple benchmarks.
